_comment: Copy to ~/.config/podcast-skills/config.json. Replace everything in show and publishing.youtube, and add your glossary. Other values work as they are: see podcast/README.md. API keys never go here: put them in the file named by paths.env_file. Scripts look for --config, then $PODCAST_CONFIG, then the path above.

show._comment: slug is the show's name in lowercase with dashes. publisher is the person or company behind the show, used in the episode page schema.
show.name: Example Show

rules: Numbers over adjectives: '20 years roasting' beats 'extensive experience'.
Named things over generic ones: use the real award, tool or company name.

glossary._comment: Wrong spelling on the left, right spelling on the right. Speech-to-text gets names wrong, so skills apply this everywhere.

font_files._comment: Family name to font file, for fonts the pack does not bundle. Example: "My Font": "~/Fonts/MyFont.ttf". You must hold the licence for anything you add.

paths._comment: media_archive can be any folder, not only an external drive.

youtube._comment: channel_id is the upload guard: see Setup in distribute/SKILL.md. category_id 22 is People & Blogs.
host_cta_block: One or two sentences on what the show is and who it is for.
How a guest can get in touch.

linkedin._comment: mode: paste-pack writes captions for you to post by hand (no account needed). ghl pushes drafts to GoHighLevel. off skips LinkedIn. account_name_match is only for ghl, when a location has several LinkedIn accounts.
